title: Deeper/broader peer admission and stage-specific evidence refresh
mode: primary-source web research and read-only plan refinement
scope: Refresh current LibreDWG security failure classes against existing local safety owners
Separate FreeCAD DXF importer qualification from converter-mediated DWG qualification
Recheck ezdxf XREF operation limits without generalizing them to base parsing
Refine optional peer admission to preserve fast local implementation slices

method.kind: Read current upstream project release notes, source, and documentation and reconcile with local plan
method.limitations: Upstream main/master documentation is mutable and peer release notes describe peer-specific paths, not libdxfrw defects. FreeCAD behavior was source/documentation-reviewed only; no installed build or native route was qualified.

sources.revision: Release notes for 0.14.1 dated 2026-07-25; page reviewed 2026-10-18
sources.observed: The release notes record distinct decompression logical-size/capacity drift, count-times-size overflow, invalid section page offsets/ranges, object-pointer invalidation across container growth, and malformed pre-R13 no-progress paths. These mechanisms map to existing local bounds, arithmetic, identity, and progress owners, but do not prove corresponding libdxfrw defects.

sources.project: FreeCAD DXF/DWG route documentation and wrapper
sources.observed: Documentation distinguishes native C++ and optional legacy Python DXF importer coverage. DWG is converted to DXF through a selected external converter before the importer is called. The inspected LibreDWG wrapper path waits for the process and then treats expected output-file existence as success; this is a route-stage qualification concern, not an observed failure in a pinned installed build.

The cross-document XREF helper documents support for a bounded copyable/transformable subset and identifies ACAD_TABLE and preserved unknown tag-storage entities/objects as unsupported and possibly ignored without exceptions. This scope does not establish behavior of the base reader or general same-document writer.

sources.revision: Mutable main README reviewed 2026-10-18; project labels current artifact pre-alpha
sources.observed: The project continues to distinguish a more mature DWG container path from alpha entity decoding and reports its own exact corpus/coverage status. This remains an optional structural comparator candidate, not production parity, writer acceptance, or 3D semantic evidence.

assessment.planImpact: Strengthens existing peer and consumer gates: require a named unresolved question, exact version/direction/operation overlap, pinned artifact, and independently authored expected values before an optional peer run. Separates direct FreeCAD DXF import from converter-mediated DWG import, and confines ezdxf XREF omission claims to that operation. Keeps implementation slices on focused local tests and maps LibreDWG failure classes to existing safety owners.

implementationReadyChecks: Name the unresolved field or record, source profile, direction, operation, and expected value before selecting a peer; otherwise record NOT_ADMITTED and continue local work.
For touched readers, combine independent semantic expectations, bounded exact consumption/progress, and a following-record/object sentinel in the existing owning fast target.
For touched writers, inspect physical tags/bytes and graph/output closure with test-side checks; reserve independent peer/native validation for the composed checkpoint.
For FreeCAD, test libdxfrw-produced DXF directly in a pinned selected importer; keep DWG converter status, fresh intermediate DXF validation, and importer outcome as separate stages.
Treat ezdxf XREF as a cross-document copy operation with explicit omissions, not as evidence about its base parser or same-document writer.
Do not add external peer/customer drawings, dependencies, CTest registrations, broad per-slice suites, or support-claim promotions from this research.

workingTree.reason: The shared checkout contains extensive pre-existing user changes. This pass edited only the plan and added this research receipt; all other changes were preserved.
